topic: Inventory activation claims, registered-read evidence limits and bounded inquiry/report contracts

candidate.flag_scope: New SDK structured evidence phase only. Common input/format/checker code is a separate candidate; none installed operating.

changes.activation: An IP inventory is not feature activation proof; attached unknown/negative modality and separate finite claims are distinguished. A full FW read remains separate evidence.
changes.coverage: Reuse existing read classifiers and actual registered catalog. Known available/completed/failed reads require evidence-scope review rather than a feature-absence claim; aggregate count needs are not established by sample search. This is a limited checker, not complete semantic verification.
changes.negative_http: Use shared modality including evidence/proof noun phrases and coordinated outcome negation; keep positive/double-negative outcome rejection.
changes.feedback: Bounded executor issue codes plus actual registered-read ordinal/hash/error/list cardinality. Prior model output remains untrusted and raw response audit retained.
changes.pending_steps: While actual read budget remains, final next_steps has minItems=0/maxItems=0; needed actual reads still use more_evidence/calls, real limitations stay limitations. After budget exhaustion pending read proposals or unsupported-scope needs remain possible and unexecuted.
changes.display: An unmet-evidence step no longer automatically declares feature development necessary.
